title: Atithi Devo Bhaba — Odia food directory lead
scope: User-supplied restaurant link reviewed and saved for food-directory research; no publication or outreach.
method: Read non-www homepage through web retrieval. Contact page details available in search-indexed text; direct contact-page retrieval failed. Research query for Atithi returned no match.

identity.name: Atithi Devo Bhaba
identity.address: A/54, opposite Law University, Saheed Nagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751007

sources.scope: Operator describes vegetarian and non-vegetarian Odia dining, Kansa thali service, Chakuli Mutton, Khasi Mansa, Pakhala, fish/prawn/chicken Patra Poda, Chhena Poda and Poda Pitha. Address and contacts in footer.
Indexed operator text lists daily opening 11:00–23:00, lunch 12:00–16:00, dinner 20:00–23:00 and takeaway. Confirm before travel; indexed text is not live operating confirmation.
Menu landing page read on 20 October 2026; names thalis, Khasi Mansa, chicken, fish, Patra Poda, Pakhala, Chakuli, Pitha and Chhena Poda. Prices and full menu attachment not inspected.

editorial_use: Potential Bhubaneswar food stop for an arrival/departure itinerary and a restaurant lead linked to existing dish research. Earlier exclusion of city resorts does not establish exclusion of city food research.
limits: Menu descriptions are operator claims, not evidence of historical origins or universal recipes.
No independent assessment of food, hygiene, service, accessibility, prices or international-visitor readiness.
Website testimonials do not independently verify quality or establish a recurring festival menu.
No Alliance membership, partnership or endorsement established.
next_checks: Obtain dated menu and prices, seasonal availability and ingredient/allergen information.
Assess service and access locally before recommending or considering Alliance membership.
Ask whether a guided tasting or cook-led introduction can be arranged; neither is established by this review.
